pvgis._src: PVGIS API v5.3, SARAH3 irradiance with ERA5 temperature and wind, the full available period. Horizon from the PVGIS DEM: at most 5,7°, all of it to the north, so it does not shade a south-facing array.

array._src: kWp, module count, tilt and azimuth come from design.json. 'tilts' are the two options under decision (plan Phase 3). 2 strings x 6 modules: 07-proracuni D.1.

issu._src: Huawei iSSU S4875G2 datasheet (issue 2026-01-15, hamzici-hybrid-solar/EQUIPEMENT), Figure 2, digitised from the vector curve. The Vin = 330 V curve is used because the string (Vmp 257 V at STC) is nearer 330 V than 400 V. Losses below the first curve point (10,5 A) are extrapolated with a fitted loss model p0 + p1*P + p2*P^2. Output limit 4000 W with the Figure 3 temperature derating, applied to cabinet air = ambient + cabinet_rise_c (the rise is an assumption).

_src.iam_a_r, faiman_u0/u1, huld_k_version: The PVGIS model for free-standing c-Si (Martin-Ruiz IAM a_r 0,16; Faiman 26,9 / 6,2; Huld coefficients). Keeping PVGIS's module model lets pvsim validate against PVGIS hour by hour; iPV585-M2A temperature and low-light coefficients are not in any vendor file on hand.
_src.soiling_monthly: Assumption: 1-2,5 %/month, higher in the dry summer; a 45-60° array sheds dust with rain.
_src.snow_monthly: Assumption: at 1076 m in the bura belt, snow cover of the bottom row on snow days (bottom edge +0,50 m, ground snow up to ~0,5 m). At 60° snow slides off faster, so the losses are halved. Not modelled from snowfall data - PVGIS provides none.
_src.mismatch: Assumption: 0,3 %, because a per-module optimizer removes most string mismatch.
_src.dc_wiring_stc: 07-proracuni D.2: 0,78 % at Imp (6 mm², 25 m), scaled with current squared (i.e. with power).
_src.optimizer_eff: Huawei SUN2000-600W-P, weighted efficiency 99,0 % (vendor class figure).

load._src: base_w: TK load of 1180 W nominal (RFI 27.04.2026; Prilog III site data). cooling_w_max: the same source gives 1330 W maximum 'with cooling', i.e. up to 150 W for cabinet cooling (ICC360 HXC300L heat exchanger plus the PC1500D-1 DC air conditioner of the battery compartment, rated ≤500 W). It is ramped linearly with ambient temperature from 20 to 35 °C; the ramp is an assumption. aux_w: SMU, BMS, rectifier/iSSU standby and fans, which are not in the TK figure - an assumption.

battery.label: 6 × 150 Ah LFP
battery._src: 6 x 150 Ah LFP = 48,6 kWh as stated in the Prijedlog Odluke, Aneks 2 ('6x150 Ah (48,6 kWh), DoD min. 85 %'); Investor's decision 11.09.2026. 8,1 kWh per module reproduces the Odluka's 48,6 kWh. The Huawei quotation on file (6 x ESM-48100A6, 48 V / 100 Ah = 28,8 kWh) is outdated - it also still quotes 540 W modules - and is kept as a sensitivity case. Efficiencies (95 % round trip) and the 5 % BMS floor are NOT in any vendor file on hand - assumptions typical for LFP telecom modules. Charge limit 0,5 C: the setting Prilog I §4.6 (Rev 9) asks for, i.e. the highest the BMS allows, so that the charge current never holds the genset below its 9,5 kW cap; with 48,6 kWh it does not bind. The bidder confirms the BMS maximum.

control._src: dod_start: SMU parameter 'DOD to Start', default 85 % (ICC360-HA1-C1 installation guide, table 10-6; range 5-90 %). soc_stop 60 % and min_run_h 1 h: the TD requirement from Rev 9 (Prilog I §4.6, decision of 11.09.2026), chosen from the sensitivity runs - about 20 % fewer genset hours than stopping at 90 %, for about 0,45 starts a day. The stop logic itself is not in the vendor documents on hand; it is modelled as a stop when the SoC reaches the setting.

genset._src: rect_cap_ac_kw: the TD requirement (07-proracuni D.5, 82 % of the derated prime). eta_rect: R4875G5 rectifiers, 96 % - an assumption at the datasheet class. Fuel: FG Wilson P18-6 data sheet 2019-08-14, PRIME rating 13,2 kWe at 50/75/100 % = 2,6/3,4/4,4 l/h; interpolated in output power and extrapolated linearly below 50 %. wet_stack_frac: the 30 % minimum load from 07-proracuni D.5.

tank._src: Tank volume (500 l) comes from design.json. First fill 250 l: TD (BOQ 4.16). Refill threshold: SMU 'Refuel THR' default 20 % (ICC360-HA1-C1 installation guide, table 10-8).

limits._src: Prijedlog Odluke, Aneks 2: genset operation ≤250 h/god; one 500 l tank to last ≥1 godina.

genset.engine: Perkins 404D-22G1, 4-cyl, in-line, naturally aspirated, 2.2 l, 1500 rpm
genset.alternator: FG Wilson FGL10040, SHUNT excitation, AVR R120, IP23, class H

site_derate.basis: ISO 3046 / ISO 8528-1: -1 %/100 m above 100 m at 1076 m a.s.l. = -9.8 %, and -3 % for 40 C ambient against the 25 C reference. Factor 0.875.
site_derate.verdict: STANDBY is adequate (12.6 kW against a 12.5 kW draw) but has NO margin, and the site's real duty is PRIME (review/03-electrical Y-02: there is no utility, the set cycles on battery SoC), where the derated 11.6 kW is EXCEEDED. The rectifier AC input limit already required by BOQ 3.1 must therefore be stated as a NUMBER: cap at 9.5 kW = 82 % of the derated prime output. That also fixes the wet-stacking exposure of Y-03, since 9.5 kW is well above the 30 % minimum, and still leaves ~8.2 kW of charging after the 1.33 kW TK load. This is what the 13.5 kVA P13.5-6 could not do at all: its derated prime was 9.7 kW, below the draw.

genset._source: FG Wilson P18-6 (Skid) technical data sheet 2019-08-14 — EQUIPEMENT/GENSET/P18-6.pdf. The Investor adopted 18 kVA on 2026-08-12, returning to the original first choice. NOTE the skid envelope 1550x620x1020 is IDENTICAL to both superseded sets, so no drawing geometry moved - only mass, thermal and electrical figures. The alternator is still SHUNT and the data sheet states short-circuit capacity 0 % without the optional PMG/AUX winding, so the tender's PMG/AREP requirement stands and is now backed by the sheet itself.
genset._superseded: P13.5-6 (Rev 7, 2026-08-11): 13.5 kVA/10.8 kW, Perkins 403D-15G 1.5 l, FGL10020, 302/308 kg, 4.0 l/h — WITHDRAWN because the site derate takes it to 9.7 kW prime, below the 12.5 kW rectifier draw. P22-6 (Rev 1-6): 22 kVA/17.6 kW, Perkins 404D-22G, FGL10060, 378/385 kg, 5.9 l/h.

tank._source: FG Wilson 500 l indoor tank data supplied by the Investor 2026-08-11: 1050L x 600W x 1310H, 170 kg. Supersedes the earlier unverified 1200x700x800 estimate; full mass = 170 kg + 500 l diesel @ ~0.84 = ~590 kg over 0.63 m2 = 9.2 kN/m2.
tank.secondary_containment: The tank is DOUBLE-SKINNED (dvoplasni) with interstitial leak monitoring, so the interstitial space IS the secondary containment and no 110 % bund is required. Investor's decision 2026-08-11. NOTE the arithmetic that decided it: a bund does not gain capacity from height, because the tank standing in it displaces the retention volume - only FREE area x upstand counts. The 2885x800x330 bund gave (2.308 - 0.63) x 0.33 = 554 l, clearing 550 l by 0.7 %; the earlier 1600x1060x330 gave only (1.696 - 0.63) x 0.33 = 352 l and never met 110 % at all. Any compact bund is arithmetically impossible: 1500x640 has 0.33 m2 free, so it would have to stand 1.67 m tall.

kada.basis: Drip/spill tray under the tank - NOT a 110 % bund; secondary containment is the tank's own second skin. It catches fill and draw-off spillage and drains to a visible low point. Sized to the tank with 50/20 mm margins so the whole assembly stays inside the 640 mm strip SOUTH of the container door (door 900 wide, 700..1600 mm off the south wall), which is what keeps the doorway and the skid entry path clear.
